title: Apartment interior design in Kyiv — from $30/m²
description: Apartment design project in Kyiv from $30/m², minimum $2 500: layout, 3D, working drawings, materials. We build it too — estimate ±5% if CAS renovates.
lead: A design you can build without surprises: a well-thought-out layout, 3D of every room, drawings for the crew and a materials specification. Minimum project budget — $2 500.
steps: We look at the apartment and talk about how you live: who will live here, how many people, what matters to you.

Drawings and specifications that let the crew work without guesswork.

faq: How much does an apartment design project in Kyiv cost?
From $30 per m², minimum project budget $2 500. We give the exact price after seeing the apartment.
What does a design project include?
Measurements, layout options, 3D visualisations, working drawings, materials and furniture specification, renovation estimate.
Can you renovate to the design?
Yes, with our own team. If we carry out the renovation to our design, we guarantee the total will not deviate from the estimate by more than 5%.
